name: laterbox
description: Parking lot for follow-up notes: /later parks a note at once, even mid-turn, after a model has cleaned its text, and alone opens a pane to work through the notes; a terminal command, later, reaches the same queue; a skill lists, closes and drops notes; a session-start line shows the count.

rewrite.title: Note rewrite
rewrite.description: How /later cleans a note before storing it: haiku (a small model, given the last few messages), fork (the session's own model over the whole conversation; slow and costly), off (store the typed text).

terminal.title: Terminal command
terminal.description: link: at session start, keep a later command in ~/.local/bin that runs this plugin; off: remove the link this plugin made and add none.

file.title: Queue file
file.description: File name of the parked-notes queue at each project's root, one name for every project. Renaming it does not move existing queues.
